title: exacum viscosum
intro: Exacum viscosum, commonly known as the sticky gentian, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Exacum viscosum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable natural remedy.
